text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That was so much fun! I had a great time!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
How was my runnin'? Was it fun to
watch?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow, ya sure sound happy! Just hearin'
that
makes me happy too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Let's enjoy our next race too!

Taiki Shuttle's debut race comes to an
end. The
following day...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Oh... It's nice to see you again!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I attended Taiki Shuttle's debut race,
and she was
fantastic! She's certainly
improved her skills.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Now that the debut race is over, the real

competition awaits...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Have you decided on your next steps?

Every Umamusume has races that align
more with
their skills.

I've felt for some time that Taiki
Shuttle's speed is
her strong suit.

After watching her debut race, I'm
convinced
she'd do well in sprint and
mile races.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is there something bothering you,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'd recommend the Big
Eight. Those races attract a lot of
attention, making it easier
to gain
favorable reviews.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
To be more specific, you could aim for
the
Classics or the Tenno Sho.

I can't expect her to place well in races
that don't
suit her aptitude...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling you're really thinking
this over.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
When you can't make up your mind, try
walking it
back to the starting line!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Why not go and see what your trainee is
up to?

Following Tazuna's advice, I go looking
for Taiki
Shuttle.

I find her on the academy grounds
practicing hard
by herself.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Nothin' feels better than blazing
down the
track!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Are you all set? I'd like to begin.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, I am. Ready... go!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it ain't Suzuka and Air Groove!
Are they
runnin' together?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! If you two are partner runnin', I
wanna
join!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Gooo!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What?!

Air Groove and Silence Suzuka are
ahead by a
few hundred meters.

Yet Taiki Shuttle closes in on them,
coming in at
tremendous speed.

Her powerful legs propel her through
the air,
sending clumps of grass
spattering against her
face...
I realize what we have to do.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy, Trainer! What'd ya wanna talk
about?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good thinkin'! A debut is just the
beginning,
after all!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: So what's our next race gonna be?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Remember, I'm gunnin' to be the next

Umamusume of the Year, and I ain't
stopping till I
do!

Taiki's determination is unyielding. I
know what
needs to be said...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Sprints and miles? Those're the ones
around
1,600 meters, right?

Following this path will undoubtedly
complicate her goal of becoming
Umamusume of the Year. It
won't be
easy.

But even if the odds aren't stacked in
her favor...
with legs like hers, she may
just come out on top!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Power and speed?
choice_data_list: Let's show off your power and speed!
Let's show off your power and speed!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: My top traits...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeeehaw! I'm pickin' up what you're
puttin' down!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And I gotta say I'm all for it! Let's go
smash those
sprints and miles!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: So what's up first?!

We now have a path to follow. Our next
stop is a
mile race held in Kyoto during
winter...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha! We're gonna train for the
Shinzan Kinen
till the cows come home!
